== Summary ==
Slip “•The Greatest Of All The Jedi” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF file created 13 October 2026), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 52, 581, 775)). Version [[The Greatest Of All The Jedi]] (Original). Not a recreation.
